sources.excerpt: C.Drive - **Builder:** Chaos Custom Shop / Chaos FX - **Catalog type:** Overdrive - **Identity:** Klon Centaur-inspired analog overdrive with three independent voicing switches for EQ range, clipping symmetry and low-end fatness. [1][2] - **GAIN** - **TONE** - **LEVEL** - **EQ:** Three-position frequency-range selector. - **SYM:** Three-position clipping-symmetry selector. - **FAT:** Adds low-end content. [1][2] - **Primary reference:** Klon Centaur. - The design is a Klon-style interpretation with additional selectable clipping/EQ behavior, not a claim of identical historical components. [1] - Exact production transistor/device part number is not publicly documented. - **SYM** provides selectable symmetrical/asymmetrical clipping behavior. - Exact diode part numbers are not documented. [1][2] - Exact model-specific voltage/current figures are not securely preserved in the reviewed sources. - Analog signal path. - Handcrafted in Poland. [1] - **C.Drive** is the archive identity. - Contemporary listings also use **C.Drive+**, but the evidence does not establish a complete revision history, so the names are not silently merged. The pedal is intended to retain the balanced boost/overdrive response associated with the Klon family while allowing substantial changes to clipping symmetry and low-end content. EQ and Fat broaden the range beyond the traditional three-knob Klon interface.
